FX-BOLT-001.says: The settings as they start: from (40, 0) to (60, 100) per cent, jaggedness 40, detail 6, branches 30, width 3, glow 24, white in a blue glow #6e8cff, opacity 100, hold 2, seed 0. On a frame this small the glow reaches every pixel. Frames 0 and 1 are one bolt, held for two frames; frame 2 is a new one.

FX-BOLT-003.says: Width 0 and glow 0: the drawing, untouched.

FX-BOLT-004.says: Jaggedness 0, branches 0, width 1, glow 0, from (-10, 45) to (110, 45): a straight white line one pixel thick along the middle of row 4, its ends outside the frame. Row 4 is white added to the sky on the left, and white on the clear on the right; nothing else changes.

FX-BOLT-005.says: FX-BOLT-004 at 50 per cent down, on the edge between rows 4 and 5: each row half covered.

FX-BOLT-006.says: FX-BOLT-005 two pixels wide: rows 4 and 5 both fully covered, rows 3 and 6 untouched.

FX-BOLT-007.says: FX-BOLT-004 with width 0 and glow 3: only the glow, full on row 4, (2/3)^2 of it on rows 3 and 5, (1/3)^2 on rows 2 and 6, nothing further.

FX-BOLT-008.says: FX-BOLT-004 with glow 3: row 4 the white core, rows 2, 3, 5 and 6 FX-BOLT-007's glow.

FX-BOLT-009.says: Jaggedness 40, detail 6, no branches, width 1, glow 2, from the middle of the top edge to the middle of the bottom: a jagged line with both ends fixed. Frames 0 and 1 the same bolt, frame 2 a new one.

FX-BOLT-010.says: FX-BOLT-009 with branches 100: the same bolt, with forks that thin to nothing at their tips added to it.

FX-BOLT-011.says: FX-BOLT-009 with detail 1: the line is halved once, two straight pieces meeting at one bend.

FX-BOLT-012.says: FX-BOLT-009 with seed 7: another bolt between the same ends.

FX-BOLT-013.says: FX-BOLT-009 with hold 1: a new bolt on every frame, frame 1 different from frame 0.

FX-BOLT-014.says: FX-BOLT-008 in colour, an orange core #ff8000 in a green glow #00ff00: row 4 orange, the glow's rows green; the covering as FX-BOLT-008's.

FX-BOLT-015.says: FX-BOLT-014 with its colours written in capitals: the same.

FX-BOLT-016.says: FX-BOLT-008 at opacity 50: half the light.

FX-BOLT-017.says: FX-BOLT-004 with both points keyed down from 5 per cent at frame 0 to 85 at frame 4, linear: the line on row 0 at frame 0, on row 4 at frame 2, as FX-BOLT-004, and on row 8 at frame 4.

FX-BOLT-018.says: FX-BOLT-008 with opacity eased from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: at frame 2 it would pass 100, is held at 100, and is FX-BOLT-008, as frame 4 is.

FX-BOLT-019.says: FX-BOLT-009 moved three pixels right: the bolt moves with the drawing, and nothing is drawn outside the layer, so the three columns left of it stay empty.

FX-BOLT-020.says: Start and end both at the middle, (50, 50), width 4, glow 0: a round dot 4 pixels across.

FX-BOLT-021.says: FX-BOLT-010 with detail 8, the most: finer steps and more forks.

FX-BOLT-022.says: Jaggedness 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BOLT-023.says: Detail 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BOLT-024.says: Detail 9, above 8. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BOLT-025.says: Width 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BOLT-026.says: Glow 501, above 500. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BOLT-027.says: Hold 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BOLT-028.says: Seed 100001, above 100000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BOLT-029.says: A start at (1001, 0), past 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BOLT-030.says: Branches keyed to 150 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BOLT-031.says: A colour written "#12345", one digit short. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BOLT-032.says: A glow colour written "blue". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
